name: Systems and Lifecycle Perspectives in Design
description: Introduction to systems thinking, its application to design and various phases in life of products; various phases in life of products (design, manufacture, assembly, marketing, use, maintenance, disposal, reuse/recycle/remanufacture); design for: cost, manufacture, assembly, disassembly, reliability, maintenance, disposal, recycle, reuse, recover, remanufacture; exploration and application of product lifecycle management software.
